name: IIM Indore

about.text: IIM Indore, also known as the Indian Institute of Management Indore, was established in 1996, and since then it has been nurtured by the MoE, Government of India. It is located in the city of Indore, Madhya Pradesh. It is an essential institution as per the Indian Institutes of Management Act 2017. This institute offers quality education to students by adhering to academic excellence, researching innovative ideas, and dwelling on all the factors of leadership. It has top and expert faculty that offers excellent academic knowledge and skills. The institute is highly focused on research areas. It is the 3rd largest institute based on student exchange programs offered.

The Institute offers both online and on-campus programs. Students can apply for courses like the Executive Post Graduate Programme in Management (EPGP), Post Graduate Programme in Human Resource Management (PGP-HRM), Executive Fellow Programme in Management (EFPM), Post Graduate Programme in Management for Working Executives (PGPMX), Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP), Five Year Integrated Programme in Management (IPM), Fellow Programme in Management (FPM), Executive Fellow Programme in Management and Governance (EFPMG), and many more.

Executive Education is offered to students in disciplines like business analytics, general management, human resource management, finance and investment banking, information systems, sales and marketing, operations management, strategy and entrepreneurship, and many more. Executive programs are offered online through various platforms by offering online study material to the students.

There are various programs offered to students in executive education, like customized programs, long-duration online programs, short-term online programs, the Executive Postgraduate Diploma Programme in Management & Artificial Intelligence, certificate courses designed especially for defense officers, the General Management Programme, and many more.

admission.text: IIM Indore offers various online and on-campus programs. However, the eligibility criteria for all the courses vary. Many examinations, like the Common Admission Test (CAT) or Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT), scores are required for admission to some courses. The students have to check the eligibility criteria and then move to the steps mentioned below:
Step 1- The first step is selecting the best course for you. Students have to ensure that the selected course aligns well with their career and educational goals.
Step 2- Now check the basic eligibility criteria to get admission to the Institute, including all educational qualifications, work experience, and all other requirements.
Step 3- Visit the online website of the university by entering the details, a functional phone number, email address, name of the candidate, and nationality.
Step 4- The institute verifies the details of the candidate. After two-step verification, the students can fill out the application form by logging in with the credentials.
Step 5- Now, move to the next step, which is scanning and uploading the documents on the application.
Step 6- Make the fee payment. Take the application pdf print.

examination.text: The examination for the students enrolled in online programs will be done in online mode. The institute has a dedicated online platform or software like Proctored Zoom, Google Meet, and many more. The students have to register for the online examination. It is important to keep the identity card while appearing for the examination. The date and time for the online examination will be scheduled and updated on the portal. The proctoring technology is essential to avoid misbehavior while appearing for the examination. For such purposes, a webcam, screen, and audio recording are used. The students can check the results on the website after the notification.

placementText.text: The institute is offering various placement options to the students. Every year the institute graduates get high salary packages in various industries in domestic and international ventures. The Institute has offered its highest package of 1.14 crore, and the average package increased by 21%. Currently, students get job opportunities in sectors like the consulting domain, marketing and management, the human resources and operations department, and many more. The institute got offers from more than 180 recruiters, with over 30 new recruiters. Top recruiting companies are Accenture Strategy, Reliance Industries Limited, Redseer Consulting, HDFC Bank, Hindustan Unilever, and many more.

faqs.q: Does IIM Indore offer online programs?
faqs.a: Yes, the institute offers various online programs in both online and on-campus modes.

faqs.q: How the results of courses are declared at IIM Indore?
faqs.a: The results are declared by intimating students through email, and also, a copy of the admission letter will be sent to the students.

faqs.q: Are the courses offered by IIM Indore in online mode Valid?
faqs.a: Yes, the courses offered by the institute in online mode are valid and approved by various reputed organizations.

faqs.q: Can we pursue an online examination at IIM Indore?
faqs.a: Yes, if the student is enrolled in an online program, they can take an online examination and submit an online submission assignment.

faqs.q: Do I have to Visit IIM Indore to pursue my online course?
faqs.a: No, all the processes will be done in an online mode right from admission to assignment submission & examination.

faqs.q: What courses are offered to the students at IIM Indore?
